description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000498
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. L00986706
SMS FINANCIAL RECOVERY
SERVICES, LLC ASSIGNEE OF PNC
BANK, N.A. SUCCESSOR BY MERGER
TO UNITED NATIONAL BANK,
SUCCESSOR BY MERGER TO NEW
ERA BANK, is the Plaintiff, and V.
NAPENAS, INC., ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale
of mortgaged premises dated
03/20/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP of PISCATAWAY in
the County of MIDDLESEX, and
State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 14 Spruce
Lane, Piscataway, NJ 08854;
TAX LOT 75, Block 2601 f/k/a
350.01.
THE DIMENSIONS: Approximately
149.'15' x 66.67' x 228.30’ x 161.05' (IRR)
NO. OF FEET TO THE NEAREST
CROSS STREET: 325 ft to Spruce
Avenue and Grandview Avenue
Pursuant to N.J.S. A. 2A:50-64, et.
seq., Plaintiff sets the upset bid for
the foreclosed premises at the
judgment amount ($176,207.84
through February 26, 2026) plus all
post-judgment interest as accruing
through the date of the Sheriff’s sale and reserves its rights with respect to any post-judgment
motion for an order for additional
sums, if procured following the
date of the scheduling of the sale.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of ONE HUNDRED FIFTY SIX
THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FIFTY
FIVE DOLLARS AND FIFTY FOUR
CENTS ($156,655.54) dollars more
or less, plus interest together with
the costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff,
Attorney:
EISENBERG, GOLD & AGRAWAL P.C.
1040 NORTH KINGS HIGHWAY
SUITE 200
CHERRY HILL, NJ 08034
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
